objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, versioned, archived, invalidated, reactivated, translated, or evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document name including abbreviation, consecutive number and title by default.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number per document type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope printed in the document by integrated TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an invalidated document is archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version used before translation is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used to define templates, validity period, archive duration and naming.

objs.name: document_level
objs.description: Level used to differentiate documents for structuring and evaluation.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or on which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_document
objs.description: New document generated based on standard MS Office formats.

objs.name: document_properties
objs.description: Properties dialog of a document where metadata, attributes, authorizations and workflow participants are maintained.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose in document properties.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or customer-specific data maintained for a document.

objs.name: attribute
objs.description: Maintainable property value used in document properties, distribution lists, references and workflow participant assignment.

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing source format used by the editing client to open the document in the corresponding local Office component.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: PDF representation automatically converted from a saved document and displayed on the web.

objs.name: tag_technology
objs.description: Integrated technology used to print certain document metadata in template-based documents.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for assigning authorizations, roles, readers, distribution and archive access.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual user or participant assigned to roles, authorizations, workflow steps or distribution.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role implemented to provide users with functions according to their area of application.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User or group assigned reader rights and able to view approved objects.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Person assigned as author of a document and signer of the creator workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person assigned additional personal change rights and able to start release but not relevant within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person assigned to check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for deciding whether a document is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person able to translate released content into another language.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, released with it and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: main_document
objs.description: Document to which Additional Information or Attachment is added.

objs.name: release_workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported approval process consisting of Creator, Review and Release steps.

objs.name: workflow_step
objs.description: Step in a workflow process such as Creator, Review, Release, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed during workflow processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete release workflow tasks.

objs.name: signature_documentation
objs.description: System documentation of signatures for each released version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Email sent by the system to inform users about workflow tasks, releases, change proposals, validity extension, override or acknowledgements.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created for editing, release, revision, reactivation or retained after invalidation.

objs.name: editing_version
objs.description: New version created in editing status when a released document is changed.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing a document, created and managed without directly affecting content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: cockpit
objs.description: Area for a document where Change proposals are created and managed and distribution lists are maintained.

objs.name: change_proposals_folder
objs.description: Folder in a document cockpit where Change proposals are created and managed.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expiry and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: validity_extension_workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported process used to process a request for validity extension.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document and archive it.

objs.name: override_workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported process used to process a request for override.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group that retains read access to archived documents.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: reactivation_workflow
objs.description: Workflow process started automatically for a request for reactivation.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning user groups or persons for distribution by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: distribution_by_email
objs.description: Distribution type where assigned users are informed by email when a new document version is released.

objs.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
objs.description: Distribution type where assigned persons and group users are requested by email to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of document acknowledgement requested and tracked for assigned recipients.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific display filled based on distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released document content checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where a document may be visible or not.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Link from a document to master data, other documents, or original documents for local additions.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: IT application named as master data or relevant equipment reference.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Creation of a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Selection of a document template when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Creation of a pure object cover.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Uploading external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_office_document
evts.description: Generation of a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: open_document_properties
evts.description: Opening document properties editing after attachment of an object.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintenance of standardized or customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Editing document content using the implemented editing client.

evts.name: print_metadata
evts.description: Automatic printing of document metadata in the document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Saving a document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system-supported conversion of a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Displaying the current converted document version as a PDF on the web.

evts.name: change_document_content
evts.description: Subsequent change to document content.

evts.name: change_document_properties
evts.description: Subsequent change to document properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of a new editing version when a released document is revised or changed.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assignment of participants in the release process via document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Adding additional information to a document by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Direct release and publication of additional information via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Direct deletion of additional information.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Adding an Attachment to a document by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modification of an Attachment.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking or archiving an Attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiation of the workflow-supported approval process by an author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review_task
evts.description: Reviewer completes review task positively or rejects.

evts.name: complete_release_task
evts.description: Releaser completes release task positively or rejects.

evts.name: cancel_workflow
evts.description: Workflow canceled for all subsequent participants after first rejection during review or release with multiple users.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: System sends email notification to users involved or informed in a process.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participant completes a task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature_documentation
evts.description: Documenting signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final release of a document after workflow completion.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_released_document
evts.description: Revision of a valid and released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Scheduling a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a Change proposal for a document by an employee with author rights.

evts.name: inform_document_author
evts.description: Informing the author of the underlying document by email when a Change proposal is created.

evts.name: document_change_proposal_editing
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: notify_proposal_creator
evts.description: Creator of a proposal receives an email notification after editing is documented.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completion of a Change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of a request for validity extension.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaring additional validity for a document.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Deletion of the request for validity extension when validity is extended or a revised version is released.

evts.name: update_valid_until_date
evts.description: Updating the document valid until date by the default value of 3 years.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatic termination of the validity extension process when a new revised version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Creating a request for Override for a document.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Automatic start of the workflow for processing a request for AKS after attachment of the request.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declaration of Out of force for a document.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Giving the last valid and approved version of the document the status Out of force.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Deleting existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoking all rights except for the archive group during archiving.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physical deletion of documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Creating a request for reactivation in the folder provided and selecting the document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatic start of workflow after a request for reactivation is created.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request for reactivation confirms reactivation in the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validating an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivating Attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintaining distribution lists for a document by assigning User Groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Informing assigned users by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically requesting acknowledgement by email upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement without signature.

evts.name: provide_acknowledgement_overview
evts.description: Providing author team an overview of acknowledgements not yet confirmed.

evts.name: notify_all_acknowledgements_confirmed
evts.description: Notifying author team when all persons maintained in distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Assigning corresponding document in dashboard for users included in distribution groups.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Running role-specific evaluation report or search with selected parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translating released document content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Checking translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Releasing translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: display_language_version
evts.description: Displaying the document in the authorized reader's login language after language version release.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specifying in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_addition_document
evts.description: Creating a new document in a client to describe a local addition to another document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Creating a reference to an original document, master data or other document.

o2o.description: A document has a selected document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Document types correspond to document levels in the example breakdown.
Document properties describe a document and contain metadata, attributes, authorizations and workflow participants.
Attributes and metadata are grouped into categories in document properties.
Metadata is maintained through document properties.
Attributes are maintained through document properties.
A document has an existing source format used by the editing client.
A saved document is converted to and displayed as PDF.
Documents have assigned authorizations.
Read and change rights can be assigned to a group of users.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer, releaser and translation.
Users belong to User Groups.
Roles provide individual users with functions according to their area of application.
Readers may view addressed approved documents.
A document has an author field and the author signs the first workflow step.
A document can have co-authors with personal change rights.
A document can have reviewers assigned for checking.
A document can have releasers assigned for approval.
A document can have translation participants assigned.
Additional information can be added to each document and belongs to the associated main document.
Attachments can be added to each document and affect the associated version of the main document.
A document release is processed by a release workflow.
The release workflow consists of workflow steps.
Workflow tasks are associated with workflow steps.
Workflow tasks are completed by assigned users.
Workflow participants complete tasks with electronic signatures.
Signatures are documented for each released version.
A managed document has versions.
Changes to released documents result in an editing version.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in it.
Change proposals are created and managed in the cockpit in the Change proposals folder.
The cockpit is for a document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for validity extension must be processed with workflow support.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for AKS is processed by an override workflow.
Users in the archive group still have read access to archived documents.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
The reactivation workflow starts automatically after the request is created.
Only the Business Admin group is permitted to create requests for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning User Groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Distribution by e-mail is a type of distribution in the system.
Distribution for acknowledgement is a type of distribution in the system.
Distribution for acknowledgement requests confirmations of acknowledgement.
Relevant documents are listed or assigned in dashboards.
Reports provide evaluations of documents stored in the system.
Translation provides a language-dependent display of released documents.
Translator can translate released content into another language.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.
Documents can have references to master data, other documents, and original documents.
Documents can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be automatically linked with master data.
IT applications are given as master data examples and document properties references.
